spec.name: Earnings drift v30
spec.notes: Post-earnings drift on the reported surprise.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.2, annual return 7%, maximum drawdown 4%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy shows a high Sharpe ratio of 2.2, which is suspicious given the simplicity of the signal. The research log indicates that this strategy was selected from a set of trials ('best_of': 4), suggesting potential selection bias or data mining. While the strategy includes transaction costs, the performance metrics may be inflated due to the limited number of trials performed during the research phase. Given the lack of out-of-sample validation and the risk of overfitting to the historical period, I recommend paper trading to verify the consistency of the earnings drift signal before committing real capital.
